title: Targeted review packet Slot64
text:
# Owner Slot64 construction packet review

Verdict: READY_FOR_MANUAL_ENGINEERING_LAUNCH_WITH_LIMITATIONS. No CC/product run occurred. Owner controller qualification **50/50**, exact14-file dummy roster/new resourcecaps/roles; fresh PS5.1 parse, missing/extra files, phase preimages, freeze/data anchors, pin drift, min child allowance, missing child usage/pending holds, no-refund and same-freeze final/mutation controls exercised. Native launcher was a private dummy fixture, no live CLI executed/edited. Independent static packet checks **14/14**; all601 protected sources match. The installed launcher must additionally CheckOnly with real source/native pins before use.

Strongest rejection case: a program can look wired but simply echo expected data or depend on forbidden ambient modules. Owner specification freezes the closed json/hashlib-only loader, source-derived selector compilation map, no expected controls in adapter view, all18 independent recipe equivalence, source-change counterexamples and real child→parent consumption. These are **requirements awaiting CC execution**, not proven product behaviour. No hard-coded expected candidate, generated historical snapshot or schema-control alias accepted. Construction helpers/templates don't count as the two actual loaded program members.

Second concern: an AILL logical durable AdapterResult requires fact association, while Runtime's current private respond returns semantic material before its own fact publication. Assigning both without a precise sequencing contract risks a dependency cycle or shadow writer. Slot64 now covers RN only; the unresolved AILL interface is explicit carry-forward, no fake endpoint is permitted. This changes the earlier conditional N1+N2 forecast, with reason; selected full O/A intake acceptance is unchanged.

M1 review of this packet: ACCEPTED_SCOPED_FOR_CONSTRUCTION; methodology review N/A (no research change); execution architecture not accepted for actual deployment. New48case/16mutant behaviours PLANNED_NOT_RUN. Prior Slot63 Owner host result remains accepted scoped/PENDING_AILL, not silently joint-approved. No additional blind/independent AILL verdict invented. Controller qualification is Owner-authored fixture evidence, not an OS sandbox, scientific trial or method reproduction.

Owner read source extents used for interface decisions: execution admitted view/program calls/judge/schema, coreloader (full), package roles/interface, existing documentary profile/selector/recipes and AILL MR response/first-run source semantics. Some large sources were searched/ranged, not FULL-read; source pins certify exact bytes only. No new code implementation/testing by Owner; no Skill/advisor/agent invocation on CC's behalf. Manual launch binds exact engineering grant/receipt, source/index/task and no-resume provenance; actual argv is not independently observed and no repeated Son confirmation should be requested when that evidence matches.

Estimate1CCprompt,2–4activeCChours+45–90minOwnerQC; excludes waits/faults, not R0PASS ETA. Source/root/principal/clock/registry/19subject acts and commissioning/run authority are not created here. No calendar deadline, no autoSlot65, no actualR0/R1/NodePass. Stop after sealed handoff; Owner targetedQC then exact next actual-composition package.
